title: 13th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/13/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: under Article 93(a) of the Constitution, the President's request for Majlis consent for the Maldives to join the Treaty between the Maldives and Sri Lanka on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Maldives Higher Education and Training Act (Law No. 7/2021), submitted by Maafannu South MP Abdulla Rifau.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Maldives Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Maafushi MP Hussain Riza Adam.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Copyright and Related Rights Act (Law No. 23/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Nilandhoo MP Fathimath Saudha.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent the Sri Lanka legal-assistance treaty to committee, opened debate on Higher Education Act and Penal Code amendments, and continued the Copyright Act amendment debate.
